events.text: Travellers are disappearing on the mountain pass. The villagers say a ghost walks there.

ok.log: Not a ghost: bandits in white robes. You drive them off.

fail.log: You find only cold wind and footprints that stop.

events.text: A woman in white asks you to walk her across the pass. Her feet make no sound.

effects.log: At the far side she thanks you and is gone. There is a grave there, freshly swept.
She smiles sadly. You feel watched all the way home.

events.text: An inn on the pass has one room nobody will take.

effects.log: A cold night. At dawn you find a letter under the bed, never sent, and send it.

events.text: A Taoist exorcist offers to cleanse the pass. His fee is high.

effects.log: He chants all night. The disappearances stop. Coincidence? (−5 taels)
He is a fraud. A very good one.

events.text: You hear a flute on the pass at midnight. Nobody lives up here.

ok.log: An old hermit who plays for the dead. He teaches you a calming breath.

fail.log: The sound moves away as you move toward it. You get lost until dawn.

choices.text: Put your fingers in your ears

events.text: The 'ghosts' of the pass turn out to be bandits wearing masks. They block the road.

fail.log: You win, but take a cut to the arm.

choices.text: Pretend to be a ghost too

effects.log: You wail. They run. It works better than it should.

events.text: Villagers burn paper money for the spirits of the pass.

effects.log: For those who died on the road.
A long climb. The villagers are grateful.

events.text: A beautiful stranger at the inn knows your name and too much about you.

ok.log: A fox, playing games. You laugh; it laughs, and leaves you a gift.

fail.log: You lose a night and your purse. (−5 taels)

effects.log: You never learn what it was.

events.text: The older children say a ghost lives in the old well. They dare you to look.

effects.log: A frog. A very large frog.

events.text: An empty temple on the pass where the candles are always lit.

effects.log: An old nun, who has done it for forty years for her son.

events.text: Someone is robbing the graves of those who died on the pass.

ok.log: You catch a starving man. You feed him and take him to the magistrate.

effects.log: Nights of cold watch. The robbing stops.

events.text: The inn holds a ghost story contest. The prize is a free room.

ok.log: A merchant faints. You win the room.

fail.log: Everyone laughs at your ghost. It had a funny hat.
